study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Supplémentation en Vitamines et Minéraux Antioxydants cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 129 cases diagnosed within the Supplémentation en Vitamines et Minéraux Antioxydants cohort were included in a nested case-control study and matched to 167 controls (13 years of follow-up).
reason: The prospective nested case-control study evaluated overall prostate cancer risk. The abstract does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Higher 25(OH)D concentration was associated with decreased risk of prostate cancer (ORQ4 v. Q1 0·30; 95 % CI 0·12, 0·77; P trend=0·007).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns overall prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive-disease restriction.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
